morphology.pattern_note: 外语专名，整词记忆，无马来语词缀变化。所列音标采用德语读法；其他语言及本人读法可能不同。资料包未提供音节和爪夷文，保留 null；无可确认的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 布兰特：见于德语及其他欧洲语言的姓氏；在马来语文本中作为专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: Brandt, a surname found in German and other European naming traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga asing yang digunakan sebagai kata nama khas, khususnya dalam tradisi penamaan Jerman dan beberapa bahasa Eropah yang lain.
senses.nuances: 规范书写为 Brandt，首字母大写；不能释作马来语普通名词。中文音译须结合具体人物的通行译名。以下搭配为自然称谓组合，未作高频统计。status 的 official 按请求格式保留，不表示 DBP 已认证该专名为马来语普通词条。

etymology.historical_story: Brandt has more than one surname origin. German and Swiss German families may derive it from a landscape designation for land cleared by burning, or from the older personal name Brand. Scandinavian examples may reflect German transmission or related naming traditions. These alternatives explain the surname generally; they do not establish any individual family's ancestry. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/brandt?geo-lang=en).
